r/Σ Work Model
Mission
A directory of every licensed business in Google Maps
Requation is being built to help bricks-and-mortar small businesses gain the same visibility as large chains — by placing them as first-class objects in a 3D map environment, not buried in a list.
Small Business 3D Maps Directory Licensed Only
Build Philosophy
1
Learn the map first. Every element must have a grid reference before any placement code is written. State A–E × 1–5 ref, then code.
2
Visual models over documentation. We build with code + visual references. Grid-demo is the reference layer for placement decisions.
3
One thing at a time. Draft template → state purpose → get sign-off → build standalone HTML → get approval → then commit.
4
Data never crosses state lines. AZ data stays in AZ pages. CA data stays in CA pages. No exceptions.
5
Prototype on Mapbox, ship on Google Maps. All current builds (dtla, laveen, lalife, desertlife) are the learning layer. Production is Google Maps photorealistic 3D tiles.
Platform Target
Google Maps JS API + Places API — production platform. Photorealistic 3D tiles. Every licensed business as a map object.
Mapbox GL JS v3.3 — prototype + learning layer. Current live site. Standard style, 3D buildings, pitch 62.
Netlify + Supabase — deploy target. Serverless functions for Twilio, events APIs, business data queries.
NEON MAPS — Advertising Layer
MONUMENT
280 × 158 px
Full-motion video billboard. Anchored to property or landmark coord. Highest tier — autoplay loop, no user action required.
BILLBOARD
210 × 118 px
Static or short-loop visual. Mid-tier. Click-to-expand or link-out. Placed on POIs and key corridor anchors.
SOAPBOX
140 × 79 px
Event-driven card. Green border = free, red border = ticketed. Appears at venue lat/lng when event is live. Powers the events directory column.
Current Markets
Downtown LA (DTLA) — CA. Grand Ave Arts District. Walk Score 98. 330+ listings. Olympics 2028 pipeline.
Laveen, Phoenix — AZ. Baseline Rd corridor. TSMC $65B + Intel $20B semiconductor anchor. Sky Harbor $38B impact zone.
LA Life / Desert Life — lifestyle context layers. POI-dense, Yelp-integrated, RPOI gold disc markers.
